## Get data

```{r}
dt <- get_analysis_data()[variable == "madrs" & part == "total10"]
dt <- dt[n_target <= 28]

# Identify treatment levels:  
trt_levs <- get_trt_levs(dt)
ref_trt_lev <- trt_levs[1] |> unname()
dexa_trt_lev <- trt_levs[2] |> unname()
```

## Observation status

```{r}
#' Tabulate observation status
#' 
#' @description
#' Observation status can be
#' 
#' 1. In window
#' 2. Out of window 
#' 3. Not recorded
#' 
#' Observations that are Not recorded cover: `now`, `future`, and `late` the 
#' latter of which are are un-recorded observations where the visit window has 
#' closed.
#'
#' @param data 
#' @param by.treatment 
#'
#' @returns
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' dt <- get_analysis_data()[variable == "madrs" & part == "total10"]
#' dt <- dt[n_target <= 28]
#' mk_obs_status(dt, by.treatment = FALSE) |> display_dttab()
#' mk_obs_status(dt) |> display_dttab()
mk_obs_status <- function(data, by.treatment = TRUE) {
  # Check arguments:
  stopifnot(is.data.table(data) && nrow(data) > 0L,
            is.logical(by.treatment) && length(by.treatment) == 1L)
  required_var <- c("trt", "f_visit", "c_ID", "state", "c_FAS", "c_SAS", "value")
  test_required(required_var, names(data))
  .data <- data[, .SD, .SDcols = required_var]
  
  # Assign BY-variable
  BY <- if(by.treatment) c("trt", "f_visit") else "f_visit"
  
  # Make summary table:
  .data[state == "in_window" & is.na(value), state := "missing value"]
  tab <- .data[, .(Subjects        = uniqueN(c_ID),
                   FAS             = sum(c_FAS == "yes"),
                   SAS             = sum(c_SAS == "yes"),
                   "In window"     = sum(state == "in_window"),
                   "Out of window" = sum(state == "outside_window"),
                   "Not recorded"  = sum(!grepl("window", state)),
                   "Missing"       = sum(state == "missing value"),
                   "Now"           = sum(state == "now"),
                   "Future"        = sum(state == "future"),
                   "Late"          = sum(state == "late")),
               keyby = BY]
  tab

  # Add percentages:  
  nms <- c("FAS", "SAS", "In window", "Out of window", "Not recorded", "Missing", "Now", 
           "Future", "Late")
  for(nm in nms) tab[, (nm) := paste0(get(nm), "(", format(round(get(nm) / Subjects * 100, 1), 
                                             nsmall = 1), "%)")]
  
  # Add `treatment` column if not in BY-variable:
  if(!"trt" %in% BY) {
    tab[, trt := "Any treatment"]
    setcolorder(tab, "trt")
  }
  tab[, Treatment := trt]
  tab <- tab[, Visit := gsub("day", "Day ", f_visit)]
  setorder(tab, f_visit, -trt)
  
  # Add display_cols attribute:
  display_cols <- c("Visit", if(by.treatment) "Treatment" else NULL, 
                    "Subjects", "FAS", "SAS", "In window", 
                    "Out of window", "Not recorded")
  attr(tab, "display_cols") <- display_cols  

  # Return
  tab[]
}
```


### Observation status tables

Overall:
```{r}
X <- mk_obs_status(dt, by.treatment = FALSE)
X[]
```

By treatment:
```{r}
Xb <- mk_obs_status(dt, by.treatment = TRUE)
Xb[]
```


### Generate and save observation status `gt`-tables

Generate and save observation status table:
```{r results='asis'}
tlf_reg <- get_metadata()
regi <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "observation_status_overall"]
table_footers <- get_footers()
footer_list <- list(abbrev = mk_footer_abbrev(regi, Xb, table_footers),
                    Note = paste("Status based on observations of MADRS~10~ Score."))
nms <- c("In window", "Out of window", "Not recorded", "Missing", "Now", "Future", "Late")
X[f_visit == "day0", (nms) := ""]
gt_tab <- mk_gt_table(X, footer_list = footer_list) 
gt_tab

# Save table to file:
save_gt_table(gt_tab,
              regi    = regi,
              verbose = TRUE)
```

Table by treatment group:
```{r results='asis'}
Xb[f_visit == "day0", (nms) := ""]
gt_tab <- mk_gt_table(Xb, footer_list = footer_list) 
gt_tab

# Save table to file:
regi <- tlf_reg[file_stem == "observation_status_by_treatment"]
save_gt_table(gt_tab, 
              regi    = regi,
              verbose = TRUE)
```

Save list of tables in `.rds` file to enable reproducibility checks:
```{r}
dt_list <- list(X, Xb)
names(dt_list) <- tlf_reg[file_stem %in% c("observation_status_overall", 
                                           "observation_status_by_treatment"), 
                          endpoint_id]
saveRDS(dt_list, file = "50_output_db/outputs/observation_status_overview.rds")
```


## Plot of last available observation 

Plot of average MADRS~10~ Score by last available visit:
```{r}
dt <- get_outcome_data("madrs_total10", set = "FAS", estimand = "policy")
dt1 <- get_missing_state(dt)
dt2 <- merge(dt, dt1[, -"state"], by = c("ID", "n_target"))

## Select relevant variables:
d3 <- dt2[, .(ID, f_visit, n_target, trt, state, missing, value0, value, chgbl, 
              last_in_window)]

## Select data by dropout pattern:
## This includes values that are NA on intermittent missings:
d4 <- d3[n_target <= last_in_window]

## Get mean 'value' and 'chgbl' by visit and dropout pattern:
d5 <- d4[, .(N     = .N, 
             value = mean(value, na.rm=TRUE),
             chgbl = mean(chgbl, na.rm=TRUE)), .(n_target, f_visit, last_in_window)]
d5[, f_last_obs := factor(last_in_window)]
d5[, i_visit := unclass(f_visit)]

## No. at each dropout pattern:
d6 <- d5[, .SD[.N], f_last_obs]

## Plot dropout pattern until day 28:
p <- ggplot(d5, aes(n_target, chgbl, color=f_last_obs)) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
                     legend.position.inside = c(.8, .8)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_text(data=d6, aes(x=n_target, y=chgbl, label=N), hjust="left", 
            nudge_x=.4, show.legend =FALSE) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Days since Randomization", breaks=d5[, unique(n_target)], 
                     # labels = d5[, unique(f_visit)],
                     minor_breaks = NULL) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Mean Change From Baseline", limits=c(NA, NA), 
                     breaks=seq(10, -14, by=-2), minor=NULL) + 
  labs(color="Last available visit")

# Save figures:
ggsave(filename = "40_tlf_source/figures/mean_madrs_by_last_available_visit.png", 
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 4, scale = 1.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "40_tlf_source/figures/mean_madrs_by_last_available_visit.pdf",
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 4, scale = 1.2)

p
```


Plot of average MADRS~10~ Score by last available visit and treatment arm:
```{r}
## Get mean 'value' and 'chgbl' by visit and dropout pattern:
d5 <- d4[, .(N     = .N, 
             value = mean(value, na.rm=TRUE),
             chgbl = mean(chgbl, na.rm=TRUE)), 
         .(n_target, f_visit, last_in_window, trt)]
d5[, f_last_obs := factor(last_in_window)]
d5[, i_visit := unclass(f_visit)]

## No. at each dropout pattern:
d6 <- d5[, .SD[.N], .(trt, f_last_obs)]

## Plot dropout pattern until day 28:
p <- ggplot(d5, aes(n_target, chgbl, color=f_last_obs)) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~trt, ncol=1, strip.position = "right") + 
  geom_text(data=d6, aes(x=n_target, y=chgbl, label=N), hjust="left", 
            nudge_x=.4, show.legend =FALSE) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Days since Randomization", breaks=d5[, unique(n_target)], 
                     minor_breaks = NULL) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Mean Change From Baseline", limits=c(NA, NA), 
                     breaks=seq(10, -20, by=-2), minor=NULL) + 
  labs(color="Last available visit")

# Save figures:
ggsave(filename = "40_tlf_source/figures/mean_madrs_by_last_available_visit_and_trt.png", 
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 6, scale = 1.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "40_tlf_source/figures/mean_madrs_by_last_available_visit_and_trt.pdf",
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 6, scale = 1.2)

p
```

Spaghetti plot of mean MADRS~10~ Score by visit
```{r}
d4[, f_last_obs := factor(last_in_window)]
d4[, i_visit := unclass(f_visit)]

jitter <- position_jitter(width = 0.1)
legend_text <- "Day of last obs."

p <- ggplot(d4, aes(n_target, value, group=ID)) + 
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  facet_wrap(~ f_last_obs) + 
  geom_line(position=jitter, alpha=.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Days since Randomization", breaks=d5[, unique(n_target)], 
                     # labels = d5[, unique(f_visit)],
                     minor_breaks = NULL) + 
  scale_y_continuous("MADRS Total 10 Score", # limits=c(0, 44), 
                     breaks=seq(0, 45, by=5), minor=NULL)

# Save figures:

       plot = p, width = 7, height = 2.5, scale = 1.2, dpi = 300)
ggsave(filename = "40_tlf_source/figures/madrs_spaghetti_plot_by_last_available_visit.pdf",
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 2.5, scale = 1.2)

p
```
